units.source_text: 时间，就像蛇腹一样，弄出深深的皱纹，折叠了好几层。

en.t: Time, like the bellows of an accordion, formed deep creases and folded back on itself in several layers.

units.source_text: 那一层一层假如不绕远道，就无法向前挺进。

en.t: Unless one took a detour around each of those layers, there was no way to press forward.

units.source_text: 每一层皱纹，所有形式的疑惑，手里都潜藏着各自的武器。

en.t: Every crease, every form of doubt, held its own hidden weapon in its hand.

units.source_text: 与这些疑惑论争，或置之不理，或冲撞前行，都不是一般的努力。

en.t: Arguing with these doubts, ignoring them, or forcing one’s way forward through them all required more than ordinary effort.
